item.title: DTC landlord defaults on loan amid ‘beyond bad’ local office market
item.description: “The Colorado office market is a joke. It is beyond bad,” said Pat Melton, director of leasing for the Canadian firm Melcor.

item.title: Denver auditor says group funded by dedicated tax is lax on grant reviews, spent thousands on alcohol
item.description: An executive from the Caring for Denver Foundation, which receives a portion of the city’s sales tax, spent more than $3,000 of taxpayer money to buy expensive alcoholic drinks, auditors found.

item.title: Rockies’ T.J. Rumfield, out of Triple-A limbo with Yankees, takes his shot at wide-open first base job
item.description: T.J. Rumfield was a big-league first baseman trapped in Triple-A limbo. At least, that's how he saw things. So did the Rockies.

item.title: RTD plans to cut jobs to help cover budget deficit
item.description: RTD is preparing to cut jobs, a step toward addressing a projected $250 million per year shortfall and balancing its record-high $1.5 billion budget.

item.title: DPS school board votes to keep Kaiser health insurance for at least a year
item.description: The school board’s decision comes after DPS leaders recommended that directors approve a plan to drop Kaiser as one of the providers available to employees who buy health insurance through the district.

item.title: How Bennett wrestling, once one of Colorado’s worst programs, became a perennial 3A contender
item.description: If John Faczak said no, Bennett wrestling might have gone extinct.

item.title: Eric Dane, ‘Grey’s Anatomy’ star and ALS awareness advocate, dies at 53
item.description: His family says he spent his final days with loved ones.

item.title: Months after severe bus crash, Central-Grand Junction wrestlers compete at Colorado state tournament
item.description: For 20 minutes, in his hospital bed, Kyle Weaver sputtered out the same two sentences. Doctors told him he was perseverating. Caught in a shock loop. He had no real memory, then, of the crash that put him there.
